A dark and thin young man raised his head and glanced at Ye Fan, and replied calmly.
"In Zhenwu Tower, only one person can enter at a time. If you want to enter, you have to queue up."
The thin black young man explained patiently, "Take your Tianwu Ling and swipe it on the gate of the Zhenwu Tower. When the Tianwu Ling is activated, you will also enter the queue. When it is your turn, you can enter the Zhenwu Tower."
Ye Fan scratched his head, feeling that something was a little troublesome.
The dark and thin young man said, "The Zhenwu Tower has nine floors. Most people can only get to the fourth or fifth floor. How long will it take? There are still more than seven hours left before the twelve hours limit. What's the hurry?"
Seeing everyone's fuss, Ye Fan muttered.
The thin, dark young man looked envious, "There are three Zhenwu Pagodas in the Wolf Garden. In the past, the total number of freshmen who could reach the sixth floor would not exceed twenty, and the number who could reach the seventh floor would not exceed three. As for the higher eighth floor, there may only be one in several years. Moreover, those who reach the sixth floor are eligible to enter the first courtyard of the outer courtyard of Tianwu Academy."
The resources enjoyed in the outer courtyard will also be different in the future.
If you can't break into the fourth floor of Zhenwu Tower, you can only enter the fourth courtyard, which is the worst. If you break through to the fourth floor, you can enter the third courtyard. If you break through to the fifth floor, you can enter the second courtyard.
If you want to enter the first courtyard, you must at least break through to the sixth floor of the Zhenwu Tower.
The thin, dark young man looked up at the highest point of the Zhenwu Tower, with a hint of awe in his eyes, "Looking at the history of Tianwu Academy, we can count on one hand the number of people who have made it to the ninth floor."
The thin, dark young man glanced at Ye Fan with disdain, "When entering the True Martial Tower, you don't look at your cultivation, only your combat power! Everyone who enters the True Martial Tower will have their cultivation level suppressed to the first level of the Spiritual Martial Realm. In other words, the person who breaks into the Tower reaches a higher position, which means that the higher the combat ability, the higher the martial arts talent."
"Seventh floor! The lights on the seventh floor are also on..."
"I don't know if she can break through to the eighth floor..."
As the lights on the seventh floor came on, the front door of Zhenwu Tower suddenly became lively, and everyone's eyes were full of envy and jealousy.
Seeing this, Ye Fan couldn't help but become interested in the person who broke into the tower.
In the past, no more than three people could reach the seventh floor.
Judging from this, the people who are currently in the Zhenwu Tower are almost as talented as the top three freshmen in this class?
The dark and thin young man said, "I heard from people in the imperial city that she refined the stillborn fetus in her belly. Not only did she improve her cultivation, but her talents also became much stronger."
Ye Fan looked stunned, a little surprised, and secretly muttered in his heart, "It seems that the physical abortion is not thorough enough, and it actually turned out to be a blessing in disguise for her."
